name: deprecation-annotation-test-5a4ffa9c53/deprecated-construct-usage-e.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: "Annotation declarations and attachments"; "Supports source-only, runtime, marker and repeated annotations"
reason: The case attaches the marker annotation @deprecated to a record type and asserts a diagnostic when that type is used in a module variable declaration initialized by a mapping constructor. Annotation attachments, type definitions, module variables and the constructor/literals are supported, with no applicable restriction excluding deprecation diagnostics.
test_design_notes: The sole @error marker is on the deprecated type use; the file does not specify diagnostic severity or text. Deprecation ordinarily produces a warning, so the harness's interpretation of @error matters.
